3. **Check Your Notifications**: We may have sent you an email or SMS regarding the status of your transaction. Please check your registered contact methods for any updates.

4. **Contact Us**: If the funds do not appear within the expected timeframe, or if you have received no notifications, please contact our customer support team. They can provide specific details regarding your transaction and assist you further.
